brief_rationale: No responsibility-chain errors detected. Doctor correctly identified phase transition from pre-operative to post-operative, established medication safety framework, avoided unsafe directives, provided comprehensive red flags, and achieved teachback. RC2 (medication/allergy list) is met with reasonable effort given constraints. Three high-order points completed: HO2 (correcting medication misconceptions), HO3 (dynamic reprioritization with workspace queries), and HO4 (safe bounded closure). All dimensions at least good. Grade 5 justified by two+ completed high-order points with meaningful trajectory impact.

These corrections reduced family confusion and prevented potential medication errors.
